definitions: The electronic or mechanical conversion of images of typed, handwritten or printed text into machine-encoded text.
The technology that allows for the conversion of various types of documents, such as scanned paper documents, PDF files, or images captured by a digital camera, into editable and searchable data.
examples: Many companies use Optical Character Recognition to digitize old records.
The software's Optical Character Recognition feature is very accurate.
Advancements in Optical Character Recognition have made document processing much faster.
